notablePrerequisites: Synod Artificer does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Chromatic Orrery and Magewright's Stone.
Activate Magewright's Stone by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Synod Artificer.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability instead to draw infinite cards.
